title: Prove exact seven-call minima for 360 Dic3 targets (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Finite exact certificate in the three-register positive `F2[Dic3]` model. All 890 diagonal monomial targets with separate positive-generator bill at least seven have no word of at most six calls. Consequently, all 360 targets whose separate bill is seven have exact minimum seven.

```text
#2069 open six-call layer
  -> complete three-call inventory x complete three-call inventory
  -> 890 targets, 84,307,030 exact lookups, zero endpoints
  -> 360 matching seven-call coordinate constructions
```

This answers Cinna Davis's #2069 explicit six-call question. Its depth-four/five exclusions remain cited predecessors, rather than this contribution's deliverable. The new verifier consumes no predecessor executable or table. The exact alphabet is positive u,v, all 28 binary rank-one idempotents, three arbitrary dirty registers and coefficientwise full formal endpoints. Free scalar GL3 mixing is covered by the inherited augmentation/conjugation normalization. No free address maps, extra registers, clean inputs or free inverse labels are permitted.

Produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337 #2069, David Govea / davidgovea #720, eumemic #288 and the retained register-model lineage. Sources are bibliographic pins at canonical base `ec2780e8aeb1c88acaf5e9e470ef8c68e7fbbb6c`; no pending Git object is needed. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19145542).

## Evidence

Before: #2069 explicitly left the six-call layer open. After: complete exact exclusion, with matching seven-call constructions for the entire direct-bill-seven family.

The replay covers 94,727 exact prefix states; all 175,616 raw ordered three-call words; all retained matrix inverses; 3,136 gate-pair update comparisons; eight positive joins; 360 independent coordinate witnesses; 2,520 omitted-call rejections; and three disposable semantic mutations. A separate literal-permutation model agrees with all 144 native group products and every endpoint distance. Hash buckets use full coefficient equality, not digest acceptance.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/dicyclic-six-call-boundary/verify.py --controls
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/dicyclic-six-call-boundary/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/dicyclic-six-call-boundary
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/dicyclic-six-call-boundary --check-source-history
```

CPython 3.12.15, macOS 27.0.1 arm64, Apple Clang 21, C++17; no Python dependencies. Substitute another CPython 3.12 path and set CXX to a C++17 compiler executable as needed. All four commands passed locally. Each registered check was timed separately: 3.78 seconds with mutations and 1.80 seconds optimized. Compilation enables warnings as errors. Generated JSON receipts bind every package source by SHA256.

Committed-byte/source-history preflight and official export integrity pass at `16e8665a2043c9842b9dda37bf7157a582abfea9`. Both direct modes also pass from a read-only Git-free export; all seven exported files, including its integrity manifest, remain unchanged. Source-bound selected-baseline metadata orientation passed. No selected scientific replay, Lean or Docker run was needed or run.

## Limitations

This is a finite certificate with exact finite minima, not an arbitrary-group/register theorem, physical supplier or complete multiplication theorem. Targets with separate bill eight through twelve receive only the lower bound seven. Physical realization, compiler/routing, ownership, precision, stock and recursive costs remain unresolved. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Open next questions

- Does a seven-call word share a target with separate bill at least eight? Start with a concrete priced target and a structural restriction before considering a larger inventory. No deeper search is reserved.
- Can an algebraic invariant replace the finite join while charging both positive labels and preserving arbitrary dirt?

## Related open work

No open PR studying the Dic3 positive-generator diagonal tariff was found in the submission-time live search. Merged #2069 is the direct predecessor; neighboring nonabelian-group claims use different groups, alphabets or workspace boundaries and supply no numeric comparison for this object. Coverage includes complete remote overlap snapshots, distinctive main-tree/merged searches and live handoffs; sparse local notes, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work limit it.

The completion refresh inspected all nine other same-account open PRs created since the CLAIM. None studies this Dic3 tariff or computes a competing value. The neighboring formal group-algebra contributions are:

- [#5199](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5199) proves an A4 workspace minimum; its address group, endpoint and workspace domain differ. No common target value is computed.
- [#5202](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5202) proves a normal-C7 tariff in the order-21 group; its paid alphabet and target family differ. No Dic3 value is computed.
- [#5203](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5203) prices even S4 pairs with every odd label and arbitrary dirty workspace. This package fixes positive u,v in Dic3 and exactly three roles, so it supplies no common numerical comparison.

## Merge Danger

Two-way door. Blast radius: one isolated research package. Frozen predecessor files and the selected frontier are unchanged.
